searchText: Why does hoodi genesis have difficulty=1? we used to have 0x01 hardcoded. As of last year april all our new devnets are running with 0x0 https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-genesis-generator/commit/0fa01170ac8f97042e9a2c07ae14832cf7ba7784 is it causing some issues now? No, was just a very small issue with postmerge era files. Wanted to know the reason to account for it for the future networks Also do you guys plan to provide em(era files) for hoodi? future networks will be 0x0
